title: Bargain the Black-Iron Gate Dock: First Crossing
description: Bargain the Black-Iron Gate Dock: First Crossing is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Black-Iron Debt Descent through The Black-Iron Gate (Distortion Gate bound by contract clauses). Your avatar of one selected deity's avatar from Lucifer, Lilith, Asmodeus, Naamah enters; this beat spotlights Lucifer as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the entry step at Black-Iron Gate Dock, using infernal court, bargain market, and chain causeway pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Infernal Dominion is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Black-Iron Debt Descent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Black-Iron Gate Dock and reveals: Why every action can be taxed by contract circles. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Earth — Ancient Scandinavia, Frozen Fjord. ice-choked waters between black cliffs, longhouse settlements with turf roofs cracking under Gate-pressure, rune stones bleeding white energy, frozen beaches where void-mist rolls in like fog. The avatar battles the Hollow in their mythological homeland, ancient era. No faction advantage — Earth is neutral ground.
